In the diagram, $Q$ lies on the segment $PT$. The given vectors are $\overrightarrow{OP}=w$ and $\overrightarrow{OT}=n$. The lengths satisfy $PQ:QT=1:1$.

Express $\overrightarrow{OQ}$ in terms of $w$ and $n$. Fill in both coefficients, including their signs.

$\overrightarrow{OQ}=$ {{field-1}} $w+$ {{field-2}} $n$
question.:question/worked-solution:
First express both endpoint vectors in the directions away from $O$:

$$
\overrightarrow{OP}=w\qquad \overrightarrow{OT}=n .
$$

Trace the path from $P$ through $O$ to $T$:

$$
\overrightarrow{PT}=\overrightarrow{PO}+\overrightarrow{OT}=-w+n.
$$

The ratio $PQ:QT=1:1$ gives $2$ parts in the whole segment. Thus

$$
\overrightarrow{PQ}=\frac{1}{2}\overrightarrow{PT}=\frac{1}{2}(-w+n).
$$

Add along the path $O\to P\to Q$ and collect coefficients:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overrightarrow{OQ}&=\overrightarrow{OP}+\overrightarrow{PQ}\\&=w+\frac{1}{2}(-w+n)\\&=\frac{1}{2}w+\frac{1}{2}n.\end{aligned}
$$

In the diagram, $J$ lies on the segment $DA$. The given vectors are $\overrightarrow{OD}=t$ and $\overrightarrow{OA}=v$. The lengths satisfy $DJ:JA=1:5$.

Express $\overrightarrow{OJ}$ in terms of $t$ and $v$.
question.:question/worked-solution:
First express both endpoint vectors in the directions away from $O$:

$$
\overrightarrow{OD}=t\qquad \overrightarrow{OA}=v .
$$

Trace the path from $D$ through $O$ to $A$:

$$
\overrightarrow{DA}=\overrightarrow{DO}+\overrightarrow{OA}=-t+v.
$$

The ratio $DJ:JA=1:5$ gives $6$ parts in the whole segment. Thus

$$
\overrightarrow{DJ}=\frac{1}{6}\overrightarrow{DA}=\frac{1}{6}(-t+v).
$$

Add along the path $O\to D\to J$ and collect coefficients:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overrightarrow{OJ}&=\overrightarrow{OD}+\overrightarrow{DJ}\\&=t+\frac{1}{6}(-t+v)\\&=\frac{5}{6}t+\frac{1}{6}v.\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\overrightarrow{OM}=b\qquad \overrightarrow{OQ}=v .

$$
\overrightarrow{MQ}=\overrightarrow{MO}+\overrightarrow{OQ}=-b+v.

$$

In the diagram, $Z$ lies on the segment $GR$. The given vectors are $\overrightarrow{OG}=d$ and $\overrightarrow{OR}=r$. The lengths satisfy $GZ:ZR=2:3$.

Express $\overrightarrow{OZ}$ in terms of $d$ and $r$.
question.:question/worked-solution:
First express both endpoint vectors in the directions away from $O$:

$$
\overrightarrow{OG}=d\qquad \overrightarrow{OR}=r .
$$

Trace the path from $G$ through $O$ to $R$:

$$
\overrightarrow{GR}=\overrightarrow{GO}+\overrightarrow{OR}=-d+r.
$$

The ratio $GZ:ZR=2:3$ gives $5$ parts in the whole segment. Thus

$$
\overrightarrow{GZ}=\frac{2}{5}\overrightarrow{GR}=\frac{2}{5}(-d+r).
$$

Add along the path $O\to G\to Z$ and collect coefficients:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overrightarrow{OZ}&=\overrightarrow{OG}+\overrightarrow{GZ}\\&=d+\frac{2}{5}(-d+r)\\&=\frac{3}{5}d+\frac{2}{5}r.\end{aligned}
$$
